cohort: 25 pregnant women diagnosed with placenta previa and placenta accreta spectrum disorders
finding: Placenta previa with placenta accreta spectrum disorders was associated with significant maternal morbidity, including massive blood loss, high rates of caesarean hysterectomy, and pre-term delivery.
mod_finding: All women in the study underwent caesarean hysterectomy.
gest_age: Mean gestational age at delivery was 36.3 weeks
